defects: Specializes the theorem to R = ℤ, whereas the gold statement holds for an arbitrary commutative (topological) ring R — this drops the generality that is the whole point of parametrizing over R and [TopologicalSpace R].

Uses topological infinite-product *value* notation (∏', i.e. tprod) instead of the HasProd predicate; tprod defaults to a junk value (1) when the family is not Multipliable, so an equality '∏' ... = c' is not the same proposition as 'HasProd ... c' unless one separately argues c ≠ 1, which is not stated or assumed here.

No explicit TopologicalSpace/WithPiTopology hypothesis is given for the ambient power series ring, unlike gold which explicitly carries [TopologicalSpace R] needed to make sense of convergence via PowerSeries.WithPiTopology; it's unclear what topology instance is being picked up on PowerSeries ℤ.

Replaces the canonical named series 'pentagonalSeries R' with an ad hoc coefficient function built from 'pentagonal' and Exists.choose; whether this correctly encodes the generalized pentagonal numbers (sign convention (-1)^k, treatment of k and -k, and the k=0 case) cannot be verified against gold's definition and risks a mismatched indexing/sign convention.
